en-US.description:
Hello, trainees!

Episode 8 of *Chalsuda* was spent with my first love, Bobby💗

It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that my twenties were filled with Bobby. Back then, I went to fan meetings, concerts, studio recordings, university festivals, and so on, just to catch a glimpse of his face, even if only for a moment.

Eight years have passed, and Bobby came to my house to meet me.

When I was twenty, I once shouted, "Bobby!! I love you!!!" toward Bobby while he was on stage. Perhaps because my voice was so loud, Bobby heard it and shouted back into the microphone, "I love you too!!!" which made the fans around me envious.

Eight years later, although he has been given the title "Sister!", I sat right next to him and heard him say he loved me.

It was a day where the flow of my life felt not just fascinating, but unreal.

Thank you so much again today to all the trainees for letting me live in this unreal reality. I am grateful in advance for tomorrow, and I think I will continue to be grateful.

I love you❤️
I love you and cheer for Bobby too❤️
I love you and cheer for iKON too❤️

snippet.description:
#사내뷰공업  @소정아리 

여러분 안녕하세요! 찰수다 6화는
제가 너무너무 좋아하고 존경하는 언니이자 선배!!
김소정(a.k.a 사내뷰공업)을 모셔봤습니다~~
개인적으로 정말.. 정말 큰 힐링이되고 인생에 도움이 되는 시간이었어요.
정말 이 찰수다를 찍은 기점으로 마인드셋이 많이 좋아졌을 정도로... 
여러분들께도 그 좋은 기운이 전달되면 좋겠네요!

삶의 원동력이 필요하신 분들 소정아리 채널(소정 님 개인채널) 브이로그 강력 추천드립니다!!!! 진짜 진짜 보다보면 열심히 살고싶어지더라구요.. 
저도 그래서 요즘 운동이랑 열심히 하고있어요 ㅋㅋㅋ ㅎㅎ (3일 됨)

🎵[아웃트로BGM] Ready, Get set, Go!  - 페퍼톤스 

------------------------------------------------
Q.사랑이란?
A. 
마크: 살 수 있는 이유이자 살아가는 이유 
수경: 이유와 대가가 없는 것
해원: 대신 아프고 싶은 것
동원: 더 잘 됐으면 하는 마음
영지: 아직 몰라서 배우고싶고 기대되는 것
소정: 잃어버릴 수 있음에도 포기할 수 없는 것

For those of you who need motivation, I highly recommend the vlogs on SojungAri's channel (Sojung's personal channel)!!!! Watching it really makes me want to live my life to the fullest.

That's why I've been working out hard lately, lol. (It's been 3 days.)

🎵[Outro BGM] Ready, Get set, Go! - Peppertones

Mark: A reason to live, a reason to live.
Soo-kyung: Something without a reason or price.
Hae-won: Wanting to be hurt instead.
Dong-won: A wish for things to get better.
Young-ji: Something I still don't know, something I want to learn and look forward to.
So-jung: Something I can't give up, even though I could lose it.
